snippet.title: ¡Colombia tiene talento! Mathias Cañaveral, el niño que viaja 4 horas diarias para jugar fútbol.
snippet.description:
¡Cuatro horas de viaje al día no frenan el sueño de este crack de 13 años!

Mathias Cañaveral nació en Anserma, Caldas, y ahora recorre kilómetros junto a su papá desde Santa Bárbara, Antioquia, hasta Medellín para llegar cada día más cerca de su meta: ser futbolista profesional. 

Aunque varias puertas se cerraron porque lo consideraban muy pequeño, encontró una oportunidad en el Club Deportivo Ciclos, donde hoy demuestra todo su potencial.

Se destaca por sus controles, bicicletas, visión de juego y capacidad para resolver en espacios reducidos. Su ídolo es Lionel Messi. 

Fuera de las canchas, en la vereda donde vive, también recoge café. Una labor que refleja su disciplina y compromiso. Mathias tiene claro que, para disfrutar una buena cosecha, primero hay que sembrar con esfuerzo. 🌱⚽

snippet.title: A Very French Thanksgiving
snippet.description:
Guysss! I'm back on here to show you what I've been working on these past few months: A Very French Thanksgiving!

Thanksgiving is the Super Bowl of food holidays, and over the course of my career I have cooked it every which way. After years of reinventing the same handful of American classics, I decided it was time to do something a little bit insane: take Thanksgiving out of America altogether. So this summer the girls and I packed our aprons (and very little else) and headed to La Peetch, Julia Child’s former home in Provence. We had one goal: build an entirely fresh Thanksgiving menu. A French one. A VERY French one. Was it July? Yes. Did anyone in the South of France care about Thanksgiving? Absolutely not. Did that stop us? NOPE.

The menu? 

LA SALADE
LEEKS VINAIGRETTE
APRICOT-GLAZED CARROTS AND CHESTNUTS
FRENCH ONION CHICKEN (+ FRENCH ONION GRAVY)
FRENCH-AS-F*CK STUFFING
PETIT POTATO BALLS WITH BROWN BUTTER AND BAY
POMMES AU BEURRE (BUTTERIEST EVER MASHED POTATOES)
PECAN MAPLE CUSTARD TART
SUZE TONIC 

In my dream world, you’ll cook the whoooole menu start to finish but of course feel free to just steal a dish or two for your table. Either way, this is the year your Thanksgiving goes French.

Our stint in Provence was a total fantasy realized, and I am head over heels in love with this menu. Start stocking up on butter now— you’ll need it!!!🧈🇫🇷❤️

snippet.title: 愛知県「余震などに備えて最大限の警戒を」少なくとも19人けが　住宅や公共建物等少なくとも15棟が損壊
snippet.description:
8日午前1時すぎの地震で、愛知県内で少なくとも19人がけがをしました。静岡県西部を震源とするマグニチュード5．7の地震で、
愛知県知多市で震度5強、
瀬戸市、半田市、刈谷市などでは震度5弱、
名古屋市や豊橋市などで震度4を観測しました。
知多市民「知多市に（ずっと）いるがこれだけ強いのは初めて」
名古屋市内にいた人「結構ゆれがあってびっくりした。緊急地震速報がなっていた」

震度4を観測した碧南市の54歳の女性が転倒して左足首の骨を折り重傷を負うなど、少なくともあわせて19人がけがをしました。
住宅や建物では、知多市の市民体育館の天井が一部はがれ落ちたほか、
震度5弱を観測した豊田市で、神社の鳥居の上部が2つに割れるなど少なくとも15棟に被害がありました。名鉄の金山駅で電車の運転再開を待っていた人
「飛行機の時間に間に合わないかなと思ってどうしようかなと。誰も空港にたどり着けないですよ多分」

東海道新幹線やJR在来線、名鉄、地下鉄各線は運転を再開していますが、
新幹線の遅れでおよそ6万人に影響が出たということです。
愛知県内で震度5強を観測したのはおよそ30年ぶりで、
県は「余震などに備えて最大限の警戒を」と呼びかけています。

snippet.title: Phantom (2015) Full Movie 4K | Saif Ali Khan, Katrina Kaif | Hindi Action Thriller
snippet.description:
Experience Phantom (2015), a gripping Hindi action spy thriller directed by Kabir Khan. Starring Saif Ali Khan, Katrina Kaif, Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Sabyasachi Chakrabarty and Rajesh Tailang, this Bollywood film explores espionage, terrorism, revenge, patriotism and the dangerous world of international intelligence operations.

Inspired by the aftermath of the 2008 Mumbai terrorist attacks, Phantom follows Daniyal Khan, a disgraced former Indian Army officer whose military career ended under controversial circumstances.

Seeking an opportunity to restore his honour, Daniyal is secretly recruited by India's intelligence agency for a highly classified mission. His assignment is to track down and eliminate the individuals believed to be responsible for planning and coordinating the devastating attacks in Mumbai.

Working alongside Nawaz Mistry, a skilled former intelligence operative, Daniyal embarks on a dangerous international journey that takes him across India, Europe, the Middle East and Pakistan.

As the operation progresses, Daniyal and Nawaz must navigate hostile territories, secret criminal networks, powerful intelligence organisations and enemies determined to protect those responsible for the attacks.

Their mission becomes increasingly complicated as they uncover hidden connections between terrorist organisations and influential individuals operating across international borders.

With their identities constantly at risk and the authorities unaware of their true intentions, Daniyal and Nawaz must rely on their intelligence, courage and resourcefulness to survive.

However, as the mission approaches its final stages, Daniyal discovers that pursuing justice comes at an enormous personal cost. His determination to complete the operation forces him to confront difficult choices involving loyalty, sacrifice and the consequences of revenge.

Featuring intense performances by Saif Ali Khan and Katrina Kaif, spectacular international locations, gripping action sequences and atmospheric cinematography by Aseem Mishra, Phantom delivers an engaging combination of espionage, suspense and emotional drama.

The film features a memorable soundtrack composed by Pritam, with a background score by Julius Packiam. Its popular songs include Afghan Jalebi, Saware and Nachda, performed by artists including Asrar, Arijit Singh and Shahid Mallya.

Based on the novel Mumbai Avengers by S. Hussain Zaidi, Phantom blends fictional storytelling with events inspired by real-world terrorism and international security concerns.

Released on 28 August 2015, Phantom remains a notable Hindi espionage thriller remembered for its international storyline, action sequences and performances.
